# Interview Coach Prep (ICP)

> An AI-powered career preparation platform for job seekers, fresh graduates, and career switchers. ICP provides resume analysis, mock interviews, a resume builder, and job search integration — all in one place.

## What ICP Does

- **Resume Analysis** — Upload a resume and receive structured AI feedback including a quality score, strengths, weaknesses, and ATS compatibility rating.
- **Mock Interview** — Practice with a professional AI interviewer tailored to your target job title and difficulty level. Receive a readiness score and breakdown at the end.
- **Resume Builder** — Build and download a professional resume with multiple themes. Includes an AI writing assist feature to polish summaries and bullet points.
- **Manual Profile** — Fill in a structured form to generate a virtual resume for analysis without uploading a file.
- **Job Search** — Search for relevant job listings via Careerjet integration, pre-filled with your target role and location.
- **Interview History** — Review past interview sessions, view transcripts, and track progress over time.

## Technology

Built with FastAPI (Python), Vue.js 3, Bootstrap 5, MongoDB Atlas, and Mistral AI models (mistral-large-latest, mistral-small-latest, open-mistral-nemo, mistral-embed, ministral-14b-2512).

## Usage Policy

This service is intended for personal career preparation use only. Automated scraping, bulk data collection, and commercial redistribution are not permitted. See [robots.txt](https://interview-coach-prep.onrender.com/robots.txt) for crawling rules.
